messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Restyle the person's hair to match the hairstyle shown in the reference images (front and back views). Transfer only the hairstyle shape and structure from the references; do not adopt the reference person's facial features, hair color, or clothing. Preserve the person's original hair color and all other elements of the current video.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Please return to video 0 and make the following change to that video: Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: restyle the person's hair according to the reference images. Only transfer the hairstyle from the reference images, not the reference person's facial features, hair color, or clothing. Preserve everything else in the current video.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"She stands still, then raises both hands to adjust the headscarf around her head before lowering her arms and standing again.","camera":"Static medium-long side profile shot at eye level.","clothing":"Bright pink long-sleeve top with a dark graphic on the chest, a short white pleated skirt, and black lace-up boots.","hair_color":"Platinum blonde.","hairstyle":"Short, tousled hair with a small white headscarf or band tied at the back.","identity":"A slender young woman with fair skin, shown in profile facing right.","scene":"An outdoor concrete dock or pier beside calm water, with a weathered concrete wall, rocks, and wooden pilings in the background under a clear sky."},"uncertain":["The exact graphic on the pink top is not clearly legible."]}}

arguments.observed_change: The person's hair now appears as a short, tousled, textured updo with a small white headscarf or band tied at the back, matching the reference hairstyle structure. The hair color remains platinum blonde, and the clothing, scene, camera, and action are unchanged.
arguments.requested_change: Restyle the person's hair to match the reference hairstyle shape and structure, while preserving the original platinum blonde hair color, facial features, clothing, and all other video elements.
uncertain: Whether the exact hair texture and volume precisely match the reference images is difficult to judge from the side profile view.
